title: 连接悟道 A股数据
description: 填写在悟道开发者控制台创建的 API Key，凭证只保存在本机 ~/.workbuddy 目录。免费 Key 每天 50 次工具调用，北京时间 09:15–10:30 暂停 MCP 调用。
description_en: Enter an API key created in the Wudao developer console. It is stored only on this computer under ~/.workbuddy. Free keys allow 50 tool calls a day and pause MCP calls from 09:15 to 10:30 Beijing time.
docLabel: 如何获取悟道 API Key？
